title: PBA: King erupts for 44 as QF-bound San Miguel blasts Terrafirma
summary: George King erupted for 44 points as quarterfinals-bound San Miguel blasted also-ran Terrafirma, 135-105, in the PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup on Wednesday at the Ninoy Aquino Stadium.
